item.title: Respiratory Consultant Urges All Eligible in Cavan–Monaghan to Get Winter Vaccines
item.description: A respiratory consultant for Cavan/Monaghan says every eligible person across the region should get their winter vaccines to protect themselves. Professor James Hayes is a Consultant Respiratory Physician who has practiced in the Cavan/Monaghan area over the last 30 years. Professor Hayes says the vaccine can protect people from the worst impacts of flu and COVID-19. Advertisement Children aged 2–17 should get the nasal flu vaccine from their local pharmacy or GP. item.title: Concerns Raised Over Councillor Distribution in Monaghan Municipal Districts
item.description: The Cathaoirleach of Monaghan County Council has raised concerns about the breakdown of councillors in Monaghan's Municipal Districts. There is currently seven councillors representing the Monaghan MD, and five representing the Clones - Ballybay MD. Speaking to Northern Sound, Cllr. PJ O'Hanlon said that each district should have their "fair share" of councillors. Advertisement The Cathaoirleach of Monaghan County Council believes district within the county should have six councillors.

item.title: Price ceiling for First Home scheme increases in the region
item.description: The price ceiling for the First Home scheme has increased by €25,000 in Cavan and Monaghan to €375,000. The two counties are among 17 local authorities across Ireland to benefit from the extension, allowing buyers in both counties to benefit from the scheme. The First Home Scheme supports first-time buyers in bridging the gap between their mortgage, deposit, and the price of a new home. item.title: Local TD accuses EU of hypocrisy as thousands of farmers protest Mercosur deal
item.description: Thousands of farmers from across the country have descended on Athlone today to protest against the Mercosur Trade Deal. It comes as EU member states voted in favour of the deal yesterday with Ireland voting No. The deal will open the EU market to almost a hundred thousand tonnes of South American beef a year. item.title: McGuirk wins PDC tour card
item.description: Shane McGuirk has become the second Irish darts player in two days to secure his professional PDC Tour Card at Q School in the UK. Monaghan man McGuirk will join Niall Culleton on the PDC Pro Tour for the next two years after claiming one of the two tour cards up for grabs in Milton Keynes today. "This is one of the best days of my life" declared 2024 WDF world champion McGuirk. Advertisement McGuirk was in sensational form all day at the Arena MK; averaging well over 90 in all six of his games
